name: t7_lean_soft
idea: t4 with half the lean (pit and head 2 px toward the staff) and the weight heel kept under the far hip, so FG-P10 holds
verdict: KEPT, HERO (#1, 11/11, gap 361 px2): the chest and head lean 2 px toward the staff and the neck sets 2 px further back, so the near shoulder comes closer to the grip (reach 42.8 px, elbow 124 deg against R1's 134) and the head tilts off the neck (FG-P12); she leans on her staff instead of holding it out, and the plumb line still lands on the weight heel
